scope: Independent OBrush geometry regressions and user-supplied surface diagnosis. No ZBrush behavioral parity, material match, global self-intersection, or image-quality guarantee.

formatting_only_source_mapping.note: Differences are Rust edition formatting/import ordering and expanded conditional layout; runtime equations and selection behavior unchanged.

baseline.note: Frozen before new Crease geometry changes. Contains0.1.4 geometry equations plus preliminary incidence-cache work; CPU times are not shipping-browser0.1.4 performance measurements.

metric_definitions.longest_edge_quality: length((b-a) cross(c-a))/max(edge_length_squared). Equilateral=sqrt(3)/2. This is the deformation guard metric.
metric_definitions.standard_quality: 2sqrt(3)*length((b-a) cross(c-a))/sum(edge_length_squared). Equilateral=1. This is the independent sliver metric and child preflight metric.
metric_definitions.adjacent_fold_degrees: acos(dot(unit geometric face normals)) in degrees on each shared edge.180deg is a back-to-back hinge.
metric_definitions.severe_fold_length: Sum world-space edge lengths where angle>90.00001deg. Unlike raw edge count, this does not multiply when a pre-existing hinge is linearly subdivided.
metric_definitions.severe_fold_severity: Sum edge_length*(angle_degrees-90) where angle>90.00001deg. A roughness diagnostic, not a curvature/self-intersection proof.
metric_definitions.near_zero_faces_14_case_probe: Final actual child cross squared<=1e-24; old historical probe used relative area threshold instead. Do not compare this counter numerically without this distinction.
metric_definitions.original_reference_ratios: Original-parent triangles/edges and old vertex IDs. New vertices are not assigned fictional rest coordinates. Per-dab reversals use pre-dab parent triangles.

final_runtime_limits.symmetry_group_policy: Exact reflected-coordinate groups admitted/pruned together; protected-edge midpoints can split when adjacent to an editable face. No welding or approximate imported-symmetry inference.
final_runtime_limits.child_preflight: Every planned child standard quality>=min(parent standard quality,0.15)*(1-1e-5). At most8 pruning passes, then skip remainder and report detail_limited. This threshold alone does not describe the entire deformed mesh.

deformation_guards.crease: qLongest>=min(previous qLongest,0.1), new adjacent angle<=max(previous angle,90deg)
deformation_guards.move: qLongest>=min(previous qLongest,0.02), new adjacent angle<=max(previous angle,150deg)
deformation_guards.other_surface_tools: qLongest>=min(previous qLongest,0.1), new adjacent angle<=max(previous angle,60deg)
deformation_guards.step_backtracking: Shared alpha1,1/2,...1/4096, then reject whole deformation.
deformation_guards.roundoff: 32*f64 epsilon relative tolerance for old-quality/fold normalization feasibility.
deformation_guards.bad_topology: Reject touched collapsed or non-manifold topology; selected refinement malformed/duplicate/inconsistent winding or unrepresentable midpoint rejected atomically.

limitations: The original imported damage is not automatically repaired or silently remeshed. Failed preview copies remain ignored and are not released as repaired artifacts.
Bounded local linear refinement preserves geometry and adds degrees of freedom; it is not persistent multiresolution or a global remesher.
Exact symmetry preservation is conditional on matching coordinates and masks; an approximately symmetric imported sculpt is not welded.
Local orientation/fold/shape guards do not detect every global self-intersection, tunneling or disconnected near-surface collision.
Normal curvature diagnostics and visible appearance remain distinct; GPU/browser matched-render evidence is separate.
No target-product parity claim is supported by these independently authored fixtures.
